name: comp-75
title: Textarea No Resize
blurb: Textarea with resize handle disabled for fixed dimensions.
description: A textarea with CSS resize:none applied to prevent users from dragging to resize the field height, maintaining consistent layout.
use_when: You need a textarea with fixed dimensions in forms where size stability is important.
avoid_when: When users need the ability to resize text fields for their workflow.
a11y: Standard textarea accessibility applies; the resize restriction is purely visual.
